source_evidence: An SEC-exempt reporting adviser can only provide investment advice to private funds and cannot legally provide investment advice directly to individuals.
question: Misconception: Because exempt reporting advisers are not required to register with the SEC, they can provide investment advice directly to individuals.
answer: Correction: SEC-exempt reporting advisers can only advise private funds and cannot legally advise individuals directly. They also remain subject to certain SEC reporting, recordkeeping, and other obligations.
